matches.rationale: Pred_1 identifies a parameter-scaling contradiction between Section 4.4 and Appendix B.6 (linear vs quadratic in width/depth). GT_1 concerns the definition of network depth itself (residual blocks vs Dense layers, and how experimental depths 4,8,16,32,64 map to architecture). These are different defects in different material.

Both identify the same inconsistency: the critic function switches between dot-product (Section 3) and L2-norm (Figure 9). Pred_2 correctly flags this as contradictory and notes the optimization-direction problem. GT_2 records the defect from the opposite direction (dot-product in corrupted text vs L2 in original), but R2 makes polarity irrelevant—same defect detected.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a genuine parameter-scaling contradiction not present in the ground truth defects.
Detects GT_2's critic function inconsistency between dot-product and L2-norm definitions.
